title: I Heard You Like Registers
description: Simulate conditional register modifications and track maximum values.
writeup:
## Approach

Each line of the input describes an instruction that modifies a register only if a condition on another register is satisfied. All registers begin at zero. The instruction format includes a target register, an operation (increase or decrease), an amount, and a conditional expression.

To solve the puzzle, we maintain a dictionary of registers and evaluate each instruction in order. If the condition evaluates to true, we apply the modification. Otherwise, the instruction is skipped.

## Part 1

After processing all instructions, we examine the register dictionary and return the largest value present. Registers that were never written default to zero.

## Part 2

In addition to the final values, we also track the highest value ever held in any register at any point during execution. This requires updating a running maximum each time a register is modified.

The solution is a straightforward simulation involving parsing, conditional evaluation, and dictionary updates.
